classificationMeaning: FULLY_GENERIC requires owner-independent recognition, typed extraction, and necessary relationship composition. Domain payload support and provenance identifiers alone do not qualify.

capabilities.genericRecognizer: MechanicSourceNormalizer structured savingThrow/abilityCheck and authored-text signals; MechanicTypeDeterminer
capabilities.composition: none; DC unknown; co-occurrence only
capabilities.limits: Single unambiguous ability only; no target/DC extraction and no claim reference composition; canonical extraction PHB/owner gated.

capabilities.legacy: PhbSaveDamageGeneralizer.saveOutcomes; PhbSpellMechanicsExtractor damage outcome helpers; condition save dependencies
capabilities.composition: No HIT/save result bindings; CO_OCCURS_IN_SOURCE_FRAGMENT only
capabilities.limits: Failure/success/half/no-damage and condition-on-save relationships are absent in v2.

capabilities.genericRecognizer: authored damage words/markup and structured damageInflict/resist/vulnerable signals
capabilities.composition: No type, event, target or outcome link
capabilities.limits: Single markup dice expression; integer/dice sums rejected; damage type unknown; no owner-independent HIT/save binding.

capabilities.genericRecognizer: attack/spell attack text and structured spellAttack
capabilities.composition: No independent attack groups or damage binding
capabilities.limits: Requires cast-time wording, one attack phrase; cannot express later activations, multiple independent attacks, target count or outcome dependency.

capabilities.composition: No target, symbolic modifier or scaling relation
capabilities.limits: One dice formula; rejects additive expressions; only hit-point restoration.

capabilities.legacy: PhbConditionMechanicsRules; structured condition support in PHB extractor
capabilities.composition: No duration, save, target, end condition or attack trigger links
capabilities.limits: v2 maps structured conditionInflict to APPLY without authored-operation proof; no removal/immunity extraction.

capabilities.capability: condition removal, immunity, choice and save ending
capabilities.composition: No choice groups, removal, immunity or save-ending composition
capabilities.limits: Legacy PHB/owner gates and bounded phrase grammars; v2 structured condition signal does not cover these operations.

capabilities.legacy: PhbSpellMechanicsExtractor.generalizedSlotScaling; PhbSpellAttackRules hit damage and attack count; owner patterns
capabilities.composition: No target mechanic relation or threshold representation
capabilities.limits: No amount/attack-count/rule application or threshold extraction in v2.

capabilities.legacy: PhbCantripDamageScaling; PhbSpellAttackRules Eldritch Blast and simple cantrip claims
capabilities.composition: No scaling-to-attack/damage link
capabilities.limits: PHB source and enumerated cantrip interpretation; character-level intervals are not generic v2 behavior.

capabilities.legacy: PhbModifierAndProtectionRules (named methods for Bane, Barkskin, Bless, Longstrider, Mage Armor, Shield of Faith)
capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: Operation-specific typed payloads exist; extraction contains owner-specific branches.

capabilities.genericStrategy: damage or condition payload only, no resistance operation
capabilities.composition: No prevention/qualifier relation
capabilities.limits: Resistance, vulnerability, damage prevention and effect-specific exemptions are not represented by v2 strategies.

capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: Reaction cost/trigger and prevention windows are source-specific legacy extractions.

capabilities.genericRecognizer: duration context fragment retained but not classified
capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: No duration or concentration mechanic strategy, nor relationship to condition/effect.

capabilities.genericRecognizer: areaTags signal intentionally unclassified; text may signal damage/save
capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: Target shape, center, radius and attack-relative area are not extracted generically.

capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: No per-target attack grouping, independent rolls, limits or corresponding damage relationships.

capabilities.capability: persistent links and repeated/triggered damage or attacks
capabilities.legacy: PhbSpiritualWeaponRules; PhbWitchBoltRules; PhbSpellAttackRules Melf's Acid Arrow
capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: No establishment conditions, activation timing, repeat semantics, termination or delayed damage relationships.

capabilities.composition: none
capabilities.limits: Finite enchanted set, alternate attack actor, caster attribution, per-use consumption and expiration are not recognized.

capabilities.composition: No trigger independent of HIT/MISS, area/save/damage chain
capabilities.limits: No after-attack regardless-of-outcome event composition.

capabilities.composition: No die-face condition, bounded chain, target exclusions or recursive rule reference
capabilities.limits: No damage-roll condition or conditional attack chain in v2.

capabilities.genericStrategy: all generic strategies share candidate fragment
capabilities.composition: evidence deduplicated by resource/pointer; associations point to mechanics
capabilities.limits: v2 evidence is whole-fragment spans, text spans are 0..String.length, and current fragment recognition does not use the legacy verifier's exact phrase spans; semantic support is not proven by structural validity.
